Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: The address's own activity, from the first page of its ledger and of its fills.

ArchiveEstimate.title: ArchiveEstimate
ArchiveEstimate.description: What a sync would read from the paid Hyperliquid archive (AWS S3, requester pays).

Balance.title: Balance
Balance.description:
A ledger balance: the sum of the legs of one non-perpetual asset (rule 46.1).

A perpetual's legs sum to its position's `size`, which is served in `positions` with the
`instrument` (rule 34.1); balances hold `asset`, `nft` and `share` keys only.

Binding.title: Binding
Binding.description: An hl resource: one HyperCore user address, immutable (units/hl/index.md rule 1).

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.description: `GET`/`PUT …/resources/{r}/budget` (rule 4.6, rule 16 row 23): a hard limit set by a tenant admin (policy 02 access rule 7.2).

BudgetRequest.title: BudgetRequest
BudgetRequest.description: `PUT …/budget`: the hard limit and what it covers.

Cash.title: Cash
Cash.description: The settled cash view of a `notional` margin compartment (rule 46.2).

ChangesPage.title: ChangesPage
ChangesPage.description: `GET …/changes` (sync.md rule 9): litmus-state's page with the schema and resource header.

Checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
Checkpoint.description: One comparison of the records' balance with an independent source (rule 48).

EditResolve.title: EditResolve
EditResolve.description: An edit whose application clears the item (rule 50.2).

EvidenceChange.title: EvidenceChange
EvidenceChange.description: An evidence entry added to or retired from the closure after `since`.

EvidenceFragment.title: EvidenceFragment
EvidenceFragment.description: The part of an evidence object a locator points at (rule 13.2).

EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef
EvidenceRef.description: One evidence object a record derives from (rule 27).

Instrument.title: Instrument
Instrument.description: A perpetual as the catalogue currently resolves it; attached at read, never stored (rule 34).

JobAccepted.title: JobAccepted
JobAccepted.description: The `202` body of every job route (rule 4.2).

JobActor.title: JobActor
JobActor.description: Who started the job (policy 02 access rule 5).

JobError.title: JobError
JobError.description: Why a job failed: the failure's type name and message, never a traceback.

Leg.title: Leg
Leg.description: One signed balance effect of a record on one `(compartment, asset)` (rule 30).

MeterUsage.title: MeterUsage
MeterUsage.description: One meter's total: provider cost in USD plus the raw quantity (policy 02 interfaces rule 10.2).

NoOptions.title: NoOptions
NoOptions.description: The request body of a job kind without options: `{}` or none.

PageCount.title: PageCount
PageCount.description: How many rows one history page held.

PayloadChange.title: PayloadChange
PayloadChange.description: A payload written after `since`, as it is now.

Position.title: Position
Position.description: An open perpetual position with venue facts only (rule 46.3); `size` is the sum of its `perpetual` legs.

Probe.title: Probe
Probe.description: Everything the add-account flow shows for a Hyperliquid address; each part carries its own `error`.

Problem.title: Problem
Problem.description: Every non-2xx body (rule 14, RFC 9457), plus typed extension members.

Record.title: Record
Record.description: One economic event of a resource (rule 21); no other top-level field is allowed.

RecordChange.title: RecordChange
RecordChange.description: A record written after `since`, as it is now: its stored body is the record.

ResourceCreate.title: ResourceCreate
ResourceCreate.description: A new resource: its name and its immutable binding (rule 2.1).

ResourceDeletion.title: ResourceDeletion
ResourceDeletion.description: `DELETE /resources/{r}`: the resource, its state and its change log are gone (rule 2.4).

ResourcePage.title: ResourcePage
ResourcePage.description: `GET /resources` (rule 15): only the resources the credential covers.

ResourceUsage.title: ResourceUsage
ResourceUsage.description: `GET …/resources/{r}/usage` (rule 4.5, rule 16 row 22): what the resource's jobs spent in the period.

RoleInfo.title: RoleInfo
RoleInfo.description: What Hyperliquid says the address is.

RouteResolve.title: RouteResolve
RouteResolve.description: A route whose call clears the item (rule 50.2); never a command line.

SubAccountInfo.title: SubAccountInfo
SubAccountInfo.description: One sub-account of the probed master, with its balances as `subAccounts` reports them.

SubAccounts.title: SubAccounts
SubAccounts.description: The master's sub-accounts; each can become its own account and resource.

TenantUsage.title: TenantUsage
TenantUsage.description: What the tenant spent outside any resource (probes) in the period.

UsageOverview.title: UsageOverview
UsageOverview.description: `GET /usage` (rule 16 row 22): one page of the covered resources' usage, by name, and the tenant's own.

VaultInfo.title: VaultInfo
VaultInfo.description: One vault the address holds equity in.

Vaults.title: Vaults
Vaults.description: Vault equities of the address; they are positions of this account, not accounts of their own.
